'''Darel-Ka''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] Mystic. In the [[Spirit World]] at the [[Shrine of Healing]] [[Mala-Ren]] asked potential [[Voss Mystics]] question about Darel-Ka's vision about a Voss who needed healing.
